title_en: Chinese History (6/20): Cai Lun and the Invention of Paper
note_en: Verb + 起来 + adjective gives an overall impression of what an action is like to do: 书写起来也很方便 "it was also very convenient to write on." Here 起来 has nothing to do with "up"; it works like English "it's easy to …" or "… writes well," but Chinese keeps the verb first: 说起来容易, 做起来难 "easier said than done."
